title: Money and quantity
description: Currency amounts are integer counts of the currency's minor unit, 0 to 2^53-1 (DEC-2026-10-16 money-and-value-lists M1 to M4). There is no minor_units flag and no sign: direction is a separate field. NGN 20,000.00 is 2000000. The exponent lives in contracts/currencies.json and is never a field of a document.

MinorAmount.description: An integer count of a minor unit. JSON Schema 'integer' with the M3 bounds, never 'number'. The validator treats a literal written with a decimal point or exponent (2000000.0, 2e6) as not an integer; Go and Python decoders must do the same (M4).

CurrencyCode.description: ISO 4217 code present in contracts/currencies.json. The validator fails when this list and the table differ.

PackUnit.description: A non-currency unit declared by a pack, with its own integer scale (M8). Core never assumes a Quantity is money.

Quantity.description: The SoT-fixed Quantity slot value: 'value' and 'unit'. When unit is a currency, value is in minor units (M2).
